name: Nodepop
//: overrides.qs: express 4 and body-parser 1 used to pin qs to ~6.15, whose last
release has two advisories (array-limit bypass GHSA-x5fp-wj9c-mxmx, and isBuffer
DoS GHSA-4mjr-xmp4-gh2g) fixed in 6.16.0; 6.16.1 then fixed the stringify DoS
1.20.9 require ~6.16.0 on their own now, which covers the first two, and the
third whenever the lock resolves 6.16.1 or later. The override stays for the
6.17 line, which every request's query string goes through: 6.17.0 and 6.17.1
harden the parser (an own __proto__ key copied as data, bracket-wrapped
prototype keys guarded at depth 0, arrayLimit counted on the elements of a
sparse array) and 6.16.2 did not take those fixes. `npm ls qs` reports
"overridden" because 6.17 is outside ~6.16. Remove the override once express
and body-parser require ~6.17 themselves; dropping it earlier goes back to the
6.16 line, which is fine for the advisories but not for those fixes.
